collections.title: Linear Algebra · Foundations
collections.summary: Elimination and bases; determinants, orthogonality and eigenvectors; dual spaces. Choose the finite-dimensional operator or numerical matrix bridge as a next step.

collections.title: Matrix Operators · From Eigenvectors to Continuous Time
collections.summary: A four-lecture route from Cayley–Hamilton and the minimal polynomial to generalized eigenspaces, spectral projectors, and matrix exponentials.
assumed_background: Matrix multiplication, determinants, characteristic polynomials and simple eigenspaces. Basic derivatives and scalar exponentials are useful for the final lecture.

collections.title: Numerical Matrix Algorithms · From Elimination to Reliable Recovery
collections.summary: A constructive route through pivoted LU and rank, stable orthogonal QR and least squares, residual/conditioning bounds, and rank-aware pseudoinverse methods.
assumed_background: Basic elimination, matrix multiplication, vector length, inner products and the idea of least squares. Ordinary eigenvectors and singular values help with the final lecture.
